scope: Email says and changes read, unread, flags and importance.

topics.title: Message status in Thunderbird
details: Each message says its status first: unread, flagged, replied, forwarded, or high or low importance.
A message you have read says nothing more. You can turn this off in Email options.
To mark a message read or unread, press Q. Or say Mark as read, or Mark as unread.
To flag a message, press X, or say Flag. Press X again, or say Remove flag, to take it off.
Say Message status to hear all of it. If messages are marked, Q and X change all of them.
Opening a message marks it read, as in Thunderbird.

topics.title: Importance and read receipts
details: While you write, press Control+Shift+I to change the importance. Or say High importance, Low importance, or Normal importance.
Press Control+Shift+T, or say Request a read receipt, to ask the person to tell you when they open it.
The review says them before you send. They are also in the draft menu.

topics.title: Email menu
details: Press Alt in email. The Select group now has Mark as read, Flag, and Message status.
